text:
leah: Anyone else seeing sample-app onboarding fail after today's codegen push? auth flows time out sometimes when fetching the SDK.
omar: Yup, I hit a JS SDK parity CI failure. Build log: https://ci.redwood.internal/7654 -> npm publish gate failed.
ci-bot: Job #7654 failed · Reason: publish-gate: changelog/semver mismatch. Regendiff artifact: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/regendiff-7654.txt
jin: I pulled the regendiff. It looks like only property ordering changed in generated TS types — hashes differ so the release gate flagged it as a breaking change.
maya: Ordering changes should be non-breaking, but sampleapp test suite does a string compare on fixtures, so it surface as a failure. That's our flaky test.
omar: Ah right, sampleapp fixture loader does `JSON.stringify(obj)` and compares. We shouldn't rely on key insertion order. I'll open a quick fix PR.
leah: Good. But the publish gate still needs guidance — do we bump patch or minor? The changelog automation promoted it to "minor" because of the diff.
jin: The changelog generator treats any regendiff as potential breaking by default. We can teach it to ignore pure-order diffs (no type shape change).
leah: Short-term: can we re-run typegen with stable key sorting so regendiff disappears? Longer-term we should canonicalize comparisons.
omar: Quick local repro: run the typegen with stable sort enabled:
```
./scripts/typegen --stable-sort
```
Using that produced identical output for me and unblocked sampleapp locally.
ci-bot: Re-run requested: Job #7655 queued.
maya: If #7655 clears, we can release a patch that only flips the stable-sort flag. But docs generator will need regeneration too (it consumes the same types).
jin: I'll open a tiny change to typegen to enable `--stable-sort` by default for the next patch and add a note in the changelog generator to de-emphasize order-only diffs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 :sparkles:
leah: Thanks. Omar, can you add a parity test that canonicalizes objects before comparing? Low risk and prevents this noise.
omar: Yep — adding a util `canonicalizeForCompare()` and swapping the string compare in sampleapp tests. Also adding a CI assertion that regendiff-only ordering is tagged non-breaking.
maya: :thumbsup: Good plan. I'll keep an eye on release gating once #7655 is green.
